content_sections.heading: VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Medical Officer Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Medical Officer Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Medical Officer Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Minimum qualification of MBBS from a recognized institution along with Medical Council registration / State Council registration (preferable: MD or equivalent qualification in Psychiatry).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Walk-in Interview Written Exam (if more than 30 candidates)

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Medical Officer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 71,550 Per Month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is MBBS from a recognized institution along with Medical Council/State Council registration. MD in Psychiatry is preferable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 05 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The venue is Vardhman Mahavir Medical College & Safdarjung Hospital, Delhi - 110029.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and potentially a Written Exam if more than 30 candidates appear.
